verdict: Winner: fixed chunking. It scores MRR 0.6288 vs 0.5136 and hit_rate@5 0.74 vs 0.7. Median Chroma-search latency 7.347 ms vs 7.545 ms. Why: section-aware chunking indexed 15119 chunks but its data quality is weaker -- 844 exact-duplicate and 112 empty chunks were flagged (empties dropped before indexing); many remaining chunks are tiny header-only fragments (Abstract, Copyright, References) that dilute the top-k and split a PEP's content across many small vectors. Fixed-size chunking indexed 8301 denser 2000-char windows (0 duplicate, 1 empty), so each chunk carries more context and matches the question topic more reliably -- hence the higher MRR and hit@k.
